setup: You are simplifying log base [[base]] of ([[a]] × [[b]]).

steps.say: The rule that helps is that the log of a product splits into the sum of the logs — which holds because multiplying the two arguments multiplies the two powers behind them.
So it becomes log base [[base]] of [[a]] plus log base [[base]] of [[b]].

answer: So it simplifies to the sum of the two logarithms.
